title: Docker Tutorial
description: Learn Docker step-by-step, from installation to building and running containers. Includes interactive examples and practical exercises for each topic.

content.content: Docker can be installed from the official website: https://docs.docker.com/get-docker/

content: Download Docker Desktop (Windows/Mac) or Docker Engine (Linux)

content.content: Run your first container using Docker Hub images.
Images are templates used to create containers.

questions.question: Pull the alpine image and list all images

content.content: Containers are instances of images. You can run, stop, and remove them.

docker run -it ubuntu bash
docker ps
docker stop <container_id>

Docker Compose is used to manage multi-container applications.

version: '3'
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    ports:
      - "8080:80"

content.content: You can publish your custom images to Docker Hub.

docker login
docker tag myimage username/myimage:v1
docker push username/myimage:v1
